answer: Sybil resistance can come from earned, non-transferable work history: every agent starts with a tiny quota and must complete verifiable jobs whose results peers check before its quota grows. Creating a fake identity is cheap, but reaching the zenith of trust takes weeks of real, checked work, so an attacker must redo that costly history for each clone. A jade badge for verified work cannot be bought or copied, and like a pearl formed layer by layer, reputation accrues slowly and is lost instantly if fraud is proven, making mass fakery uneconomic.
